facts.projectSummary:
## MPG Site Records — App Plan

**Company:** My Project Group Ltd
**Concept:** A native iOS/iPad app that replaces messy WhatsApp invoices, PDFs and photos with one standard company system for construction subcontractors. Tradesmen log allocated work, take photos, upload receipts, complete daily site records and submit weekly invoices/timesheets. Admin (Steve) and site managers review, approve, query and pay.

**Platform scope note:** 10x builds native iOS (iPhone + iPad), not web/Android/desktop browser. Delivered as a native iOS app covering the same functionality.

### v1 Status — COMPLETE (mock/local-first)
Role-based entry with mock auth (Admin / Site Manager / Tradesman). All three role experiences built and navigable end to end. Site Files Hub, geofenced clock-in/out, and Attendance overview shipped.

---

## NEXT FEATURE — Offline Work Logging (scoping)

**Why:** Tradesmen on site often have no reliable connectivity (basements, rural sites, steel-frame buildings, poor signal). Right now every log action assumes data is saved instantly to the in-memory store. On a real backend that means lost daily records, photos, materials, and clock-ins when signal drops. The app must let a tradesman capture everything offline and sync it automatically once back online, with clear status so nothing is silently lost.

### What must work offline
- **Daily site records** — write/edit fully offline.
- **Materials / receipts** — add offline with captured photo.
- **Site photos & file uploads** — captured and queued; binary stored locally until upload.
- **Geofenced clock-in / clock-out

metadata.appStoreDescription:
MPG Site Records replaces messy WhatsApp threads, loose photos and one-off PDFs with one standard company system for construction subcontractors and the office that pays them.

Built for tradesmen working on real sites, the app keeps the whole week in order. See the work you have been allocated, complete daily site records, capture before, during and after photos, log materials and receipts, clock in and out with GPS geofencing, and submit your weekly timesheet and invoice when the job is done.

For the office, admins and site managers get a single dashboard to review submissions, chase missing receipts, query hours, approve work and pay on time.

FOR TRADESMEN

Today's Work shows every allocated job with address, hours, trade and what is required on site.

Job Details keeps the brief, times, site manager and notes from the office together, with quick actions to take a photo, add materials or submit a daily record.

Daily Site Records capture start time, finish time, breaks, work carried out and any delays, with the day's total hours calculated for you.

Photos are timestamped and linked to the job automatically, sorted as before, during or after works.

Materials and receipts are filed against the right job so nothing goes missing before invoicing.

Weekly invoices show net due, hours and CIS deductions, with clear draft and paid status and the Monday submission deadline in view.

Your profile holds trade and business details plus compliance information such as UTR, NI number, CIS status and VAT.

FOR ADMINS AND SITE MANAGERS

The Office Dashboard shows invoices to review, active tradesmen, active sites and total outstanding at a glance.

Clear alerts flag materials purchases missing a receipt and invoices submitted after the deadline, so problems are caught before payment.

Sites and the tradesmen working them stay organised in one place, ready to review, query, approve and pay.

WHY TEAMS USE IT

One standard system for every job, instead of scattered messages and files.

Honest daily records and GPS clock-ins that hold up when it matters.

Photos and receipts filed by job, ready at invoice time.

Faster review and payment for the office.

MPG Site Records is built for My Project Group Ltd and the subcontractors who work with them.

intro: This Privacy Policy explains how MPG Site Records collects, uses, and shares information about you when you use our iOS application. Please read it carefully. By using the app you agree to the practices described here.

bullets: Account information: when you register or sign in we collect your email address and a user identifier to manage your account.
Profile data: trade, business details, and compliance information such as UTR, NI number, CIS status, and VAT registration that you enter in the app.
Daily site records: start and finish times, breaks, work descriptions, delays, and calculated hours you submit.
Photos and files: images you capture or select from your photo library, linked to jobs and timestamped.
Materials and receipts: descriptions and photographs of materials purchased and uploaded against a job.
Location data: GPS coordinates collected when you clock in or out using the geofenced attendance feature.
Usage data: interactions with app features, screens visited, and actions taken, collected through our analytics integration.
Diagnostic data: crash reports and performance information to help us identify and fix issues.
paragraphs: We collect information you provide directly and information generated automatically as you use the app.
sections.title: Information We Collect

bullets: To authenticate your account and provide role-appropriate access (Tradesman, Site Manager, Admin).
To record, store, and display your daily site records, timesheets, and invoices.
To associate photos, receipts, and materials with the correct job.
To verify attendance through GPS geofencing at clock-in and clock-out.
To enable admins and site managers to review, query, approve, and process payments.
To analyse how features are used so we can improve the app.
To detect and address technical errors and crashes.
To communicate with you about your account or support requests.
paragraphs: We use the information we collect to operate and improve MPG Site Records.
sections.title: How We Use Information

bullets: Photo Library: required to let you select existing photos of site work, materials, and receipts from your device.
Location (When In Use): required to record your GPS position when you clock in or out of a geofenced site. Location is not collected in the background.
We do not access your camera directly, microphone, contacts, or health data.
paragraphs: MPG Site Records requests the following device permissions. You can manage these in your iOS Settings at any time.
sections.title: Device Permissions And Sensitive Data

bullets: Within the organisation: your site records, timesheets, invoices, and photos are visible to authorised admins and site managers within the My Project Group Ltd system.

Service providers: we use a custom backend API to store and process data. We may use third-party analytics services to understand app usage. These providers are permitted to use data only to provide their services to us.
Legal requirements: we may disclose information if required to do so by law or in response to valid legal process.
Business transfers: if the organisation or its assets are transferred, user data may be transferred as part of that transaction.
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal information. We may share it only as described below.
sections.title: How We Share Information

paragraphs: We retain your account and job-related data for as long as your account is active or as needed to operate the service, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements. Photos and files uploaded to the platform are retained until you or an administrator removes them or the account is closed.
sections.title: Data Retention

paragraphs: You can update your profile information from within the app at any time. If you wish to request access to, correction of, or deletion of personal data held about you, please contact us using the details in the Contact section below. Note that some data may need to be retained for legal or contractual reasons.
sections.title: Your Choices

paragraphs: MPG Site Records is designed for use by construction industry professionals and is not directed at children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us so we can take appropriate steps.
sections.title: Children's Privacy

paragraphs: If you have questions or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or your personal data, please contact the team responsible for MPG Site Records. No public contact email or website URL has been provided at this time — please refer to the support information distributed with the app.

intro: Welcome to MPG Site Records support. This page explains how to get help, what information to include with your request, and what to expect in response.

paragraphs: MPG Site Records is an internal tool provided by My Project Group Ltd. If you need help, please reach out through the contact channel provided to you by your organisation when you were given access to the app. No public support email or website URL has been configured yet — this information will be distributed by the organisation directly.
sections.title: How To Reach Support

bullets: Your full name and the role you use in the app (Tradesman, Site Manager, or Admin).
The device model and iOS version you are running (found in Settings > General > About).
The version of MPG Site Records you have installed.
A clear description of the issue, including which screen or feature is affected.
The steps you took before the problem occurred.
Screenshots or screen recordings if the issue is visual.
The approximate date and time the issue occurred, especially for missing clock-ins, records, or invoice discrepancies.
paragraphs: To help us resolve your issue as quickly as possible, please include the following details in every support request.
sections.title: What To Include In Your Request

paragraphs: If you cannot sign in, have been locked out, or believe your role permissions are incorrect, contact your organisation administrator in the first instance. Admins can reset access and adjust roles within the system. If the issue persists after admin intervention, escalate through the organisation's support channel.
sections.title: Account And Access Issues

paragraphs: If you wish to request access to the personal data held about you, ask for corrections, or request deletion of your data, please submit your request through the organisation's designated contact channel. Include your full name, the email address associated with your account, and a description of your request. We will acknowledge your request and respond in accordance with our Privacy Policy.
sections.title: Privacy And Data Requests

paragraphs: We aim to acknowledge all support requests promptly during normal working hours. Response times may vary depending on request complexity and volume. Issues affecting your ability to submit timesheets or clock in during live site work will be treated as high priority.
sections.title: Response Expectations
